what: Grow a logo-shaped hole (a tag with a pointed right end) from the screen center. In the loader, cut a hole the logo’s size (22em, phone 14em) in the background-color cover, hold .7s, then grow it past the screen (×1.02) over .75s expoInOut(.87,0,.13,1) to peel the cover away. In reveal, the element itself opens in the tag shape from 0 until it covers the whole screen over 1.2s cubic-bezier(.625,.05,0,1), on the new-page side of a page transition. The scale that covers even the pointed tip is calculated for any aspect ratio

options.mode: loader (default — a hole in the veil) · reveal (cuts the element into a shape to open it)
options.delay: Wait (s), default loader .7 (while the original white panel fills) · reveal 0
options.--fx-tag-start: initial width of the loader hole (CSS variable), default 22em (phone 14em·480 16em·768 20em)
options.fx:play: Sending this event reopens it from the start · fires fx:done when fully open

note: The shape uses the original logo’s five outline points as they are — to switch to another logo, change the TAG points in fx.js. On transition, the outgoing page is pushed by its wrapper to y −10vh·1.2x over 1.2s on the same curve, and a dark curtain covers it in 1.2s (original barba leave).

from.where: shared.js loader()·transitions() — original loader (white plate .7s cubic-bezier(.38,.005,.215,1) then hole .75s expoInOut, plate lifts at .55s) and barba handoff (new page tag hole 1.2s osmo)
